why: an independent second derivation of the build facts in profiles/<tag>/, from the same pinned V8 sources, kept as a cross-check oracle. Nothing reads this file: since the profilegen back-port (ARCHITECTURE.md 9.9) src/cache/overlay.mjs builds the same view out of the profile itself.
